title: The policy of one job of the egress broker (pod-broker), version 1
description: The JSON form of pod_broker::Policy; the TOML form has the same keys. The fixed denies of crates/pod-broker/README.md hold in each mode, and no policy lifts them. A policy that does not agree with this schema is a failure of the class usage (exit 64).

credentials.description:
The placeholder credentials: the job holds each placeholder, and the
broker swaps it for the real value of its secret on the way to its
hosts, inside its TLS end ([`crate::credentials`]). A policy names a
secret, never its value.

deny.description:
Extra denies after the fixed ones: a net (`ADDR/PREFIX`), an
address, a name or `*.NAME`. The audit names an entry
`policy:deny[N]`.

schema.description:
The version of the schema: [`SCHEMA`], as in each schema of
`schemas/`.

Credential.description: One placeholder credential of a policy.

hosts.description:
The hosts that get the real value: a name, `*.NAME` or an address,
as the host of an allow rule. Each other host gets the placeholder.

in.description: Where the swap happens; none: `header` and `basic`.

placeholder.description: The text that the job holds: 16 to 256 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . -`.

secret.description:
The name of the secret whose value the host gives at the load: 1 to
128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`.

Mode.description: How a policy treats a target that no rule names.

oneOf.description: Only the targets of an allow rule.
Each target that no deny holds. An open policy has no allow rule.

Place.description: Where the broker swaps a placeholder in a request.

oneOf.description: The value of each header: `Authorization: Bearer PLACEHOLDER`.
The user or the password of `Authorization: Basic`.
The query of the request-target, percent-encoded.
The body of the request, within the bounds of the TLS end.

Rule.description: One allow rule. The audit names a rule by its index, `allow[N]`.

host.description:
A host name (matched in lower case, with no dot at its end), `*.NAME`
(each name below NAME, on whole labels, not NAME itself), an IPv4
address in four decimal parts, or an IPv6 address in brackets.

path.description:
A path prefix on whole segments: `/v1/repos` holds `/v1/repos` and
`/v1/repos/x`, not `/v1/reposx`. No dot segment, no empty segment and
no escape of a dot or a slash. None: each path. A tunnel (CONNECT)
shows no path: a rule with a path allows a tunnel only when the host
gives a TLS end that reads each request.

ports.description: The ports; empty: each port. Port 25 is denied in each mode.
